definition: The MLP inside each transformer block, usually expanding the hidden dimension 3-4x, applying a nonlinearity, and projecting back.
details: The MLP inside each transformer block, usually expanding the hidden dimension 3-4x, applying a nonlinearity, and projecting back. Modern LLMs use gated variants (SwiGLU: SiLU-gated linear units), which improve quality per parameter. Research on interpretability suggests FFNs act as key-value memories storing much of the model's factual knowledge.
